Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human Interleukin-1 receptor-associated kinase 4 (IRAK4). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target by name. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter target_dictionary.pref_name to 'Interleukin-1 receptor-associated kinase 4' and organism to 'Homo sapiens'. Return columns molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
